title: Tensor compatibility of the published finite pullback square
statement: For an arbitrary commutative scheme square (h,p',p,g), a finite commutative coefficient ring A, and arbitrary N,L in the unbounded fixed-scalar derived category of Y, the composite p'*mu_g; mu_p'; (theta_N tensor theta_L) equals theta_(N tensor L); h*mu_p; mu_h. All comparisons are the published fixed-scalar ones of [def-sf-finite-projection-exchange-coordinates].

proof.text: Apply properOpenPullTensorComposition to (p', g) and (h, p), with coefficient category ModuleCat A. Its uncurry tensor map is tensorMap by the definitions of uncurry and tensorMap. Reverse the first equation by cancelling the invertible compositor at N tensor L, and then cancel its tensor of hom/inv pairs.

The transport leftDerivedUpperStarCongr associated to the equality p' ≫ g = h ≫ p preserves the tensor comparison: eliminate the equality, where the transport is the identity and the equation follows from the tensor of identity maps.

Expand theta as the inverse (p', g) compositor, equality transport, and (h, p) compositor. Expand the tensor of these composites using bifunctoriality. Substitute the inverse composition equation, the equality-transport equation, and the second composition equation; associativity identifies the resulting word with the required right-hand side.
